title: ObjectChart's option-color / dimension-label probe reads the global `fetch`, bypassing the host's `apiFetch` channel
body:
Found while stopping the plugin-charts network escapes in #4106 (PR pending). Filing rather than fixing: #4106 is a test-hygiene card and its discipline is explicit that product code stays untouched unless a bug is found, in which case it gets reported with its own premise verification.

## The defect

`ObjectChart`'s category option-color effect makes two metadata reads off the **global** `fetch`:

- `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx:344` — `GET /api/v1/meta/dataset/{dataset}`
- `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx:352` — `GET /api/v1/meta/object/{objectName}`

Both are bare `await fetch(...)` calls. Neither consults `SchemaRendererContext.apiFetch`, which is this repo's channel for host-authenticated API reads.

## Why that is a bug, not a style choice

The convention is established and documented elsewhere in the same codebase:

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/useRecordEditable.ts:32` states it outright — the read must go through "`apiFetch`, the same channel `provider: 'api'` view sources use), not the bare" global — and line 74 implements `const doFetch = apiFetch ?? fetch;`.
- `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx:461-468` does the same for its data source.
- `packages/react/src/hooks/useViewData.ts:100-107` likewise.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/ConsoleShell.tsx:245` is the host that supplies it: `SchemaRendererProvider dataSource={adapter} apiFetch={apiProviderFetch}`.

`ObjectChart` already reads the context — `const context = useContext(SchemaRendererContext);` at line 253 — so the injection point is in scope. The effect just does not use it.

Consequence in a hosted console: these two reads skip whatever `apiProviderFetch` supplies (auth headers, base URL / proxy target, draft-preview query params). The effect is best-effort and swallows every failure, so the visible symptom is not an error — it is semantic option colors and dataset dimension labels **silently never applying**, with the chart quietly falling back to the positional theme palette and raw stored values.

## Premise verification

Not inferred from reading. Instrumenting `fetch` under the test suites showed these two call sites emitting live requests to the default origin, and `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.elementDataSource.test.tsx` is a **demonstration case**: it mounts a real `SchemaRendererProvider`, and the probe still leaves the process instead of being routed by the host. The host being present changes nothing, because the component never asks the context.

Note the sibling implementation in `plugin-dashboard` (`DatasetWidget`) resolves the same `/api/v1/meta/object/...` document for the same purpose, so whichever way this is resolved should probably cover both.

## Suggested direction (not a ruling)

Mirror `useRecordEditable`: `const doFetch = context?.apiFetch ?? fetch;` — preserving the documented standalone-embed fallback to the global `fetch` while letting a host intercept. That is a product contract change though, so it wants a maintainer call rather than a silent edit inside a hygiene PR.

Filed unassigned for triage.
